completion_notes: packages/mechdsl-core/src/mechdsl/lib/plasticity.py: dispatcher with signature identical to imported reference.

Phase 5 ALSO landed the algo2code parser fixes (multi-letter scratch tokenisation; binary `/` in assignment LHS) plus the Taichi codegen scalar-only fix (no `n = b.shape[0]` for algorithms without a vector arg). The dispatcher now genuinely consumes `algo2code.transpile`: the algpseudocode at `dev/algorithms/radial_return_j2.tex` is transpiled at module-load, exec'd into a namespace, and the resulting scalar Newton callable runs inside the wrapper.

Tensor algebra (deviatoric, von Mises, return-mapping reconstruction, algorithmic tangent) is orchestrated in Python around the transpiled scalar Newton using the imported helpers — algo2code's grammar surface today does not cover those tensor ops.
FEATURE_FLAG_ENV='MECHDSL_USE_IMPORTED_RR'; truthy set {1, true, yes, on} (case-insensitive); active_path_name() re-evaluates env on every call.
Bit-equality with imported reference at BASELINE_TOL=1e-12 holds for elastic, elastoplastic, unloading load steps (P5-4 parity test).
